notes: Every numeric protocol, fixture and demonstration choice is P, not a TV measurement. LCD uses a constant 1000-nit backlight and native profile extinction to isolate LC transitions; optical spread, ambient, legacy response and static ABL are disabled explicitly. OLED uses zero response tau to isolate emission duty. All emitted arrays, clocks and metrics are D under these P inputs. MPRT is an explicitly normalized synthetic tracking-edge width, not a VESA certification or a substitute for matched pursuit-camera measurements. Flicker index/percent and FFT are diagnostics, not IEEE 1789 safety classification. Device LUTs, scanout, crosstalk, calibration and certification are NR. See docs/research/m18-subframe-temporal.md. The synthetic LCD illumination 1000 nits and native contrast 4000:1 are P; their 0.25-nit extinction floor is D. GtG reference levels below that floor reject. Both P synthetic HDR ceilings are 1000 nits with knee ratio 1, so admitted gray references through 1000 nits remain unchanged by tone mapping.
